description_en: Lists agents for the current tenant and supports filtering by name and pagination
description_zh: 查询当前租户可用的Agent列表，支持按名称过滤和分页
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-agents --jsonrpc 2.0 --id 4as3dasf654a --params NextToken=0 MaxResults=100 AgentName=chat_cli_chatbi --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgents

parameters.help_en: The request ID passed in by the caller. The value is returned as-is in the response
parameters.help_zh: 请求方传入的 id，原样回显
parameters.name: id

fields.help_en: The exact agent name to filter by. If not specified, all agents are returned
fields.help_zh: Agent 名称精确过滤；不传时返回所有 Agent
fields.name: agent_name

fields.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 50
fields.name: max_results

fields.help_en: The token for the next page, following the Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI convention. Do not specify this parameter for the first page. For subsequent pages, pass in the nextToken value returned in the previous response
fields.help_zh: 下一页 token，阿里云 OpenAPI 规范；首页不传，翻页时传上一页返回的 nextToken
fields.name: next_token

parameters.help_zh: 此次请求的具体参数内容
parameters.name: params
